# Publication boundary

- Runtime contains root/two routes and all support resources; review cases/reports remain outside runtime.
- Retain exact source MIT and candidate/native gaps; inspect public artifacts for private paths/secrets and accidental unrelated edits.
- Publish actual source-projection revision before both index and skill-coverage generation.
- Verify noneditable wheel before a serial full suite; capture terminal exit receipt externally and do not build/write/check out concurrently.
- Require fresh stable-head internal review, latest exact-head/current-base Ready and admission success before normal authorized merge/card/issue closure and postmerge readback.
- No workflow/rule edits, upstream publication, native promotion, unrelated acceptance or managed import.
